svg.title: Cutaway of a generic three-story commercial building
svg.desc: Layered 2.5D cutaway built in eight stages. OSP fiber enters from a street handhole, runs up a floor sleeve into the MDF rack, a riser climbs to an IDF stacked on each floor, a tray above the ceiling carries J-hooks to outlets, ceiling access points show an illustrative coverage ripple, cameras look inward from the entry, corridors and parking, and readers sit on the latch-side jamb.
